extracted.intended_audience: general public, researchers, students, policy analysts
extracted.subtask_description: Structured data fields and narrative headings used in country-profile entries (CIA World Factbook style) covering geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative historical and political overview of the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context such as historical formation, major political events, recent political developments, and ongoing conflicts (examples: Romania's IMF agreements; Russia's Soviet history; Rwanda's 1994 genocide).

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic location description (region, neighboring oceans/continents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short phrase indicating continental placement and important bordering waters (example: 'Northern Asia (that part west of the Urals is included with Europe)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude reference point for the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Given as degrees N/S and E/W (example: '60 00 N, 100 00 E').

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Region(s) used for map indexing (e.g., Asia, Africa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-word region identifiers used to classify the country on maps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area
rubrics_metrics.description: Total, water, and land area measurements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as 'total: X sq km', with breakdowns for water and land where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: Informal comparison to another country or region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human-scale comparisons (example: 'approximately 1.8 times the size of the US' or 'slightly smaller than Maryland').

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of land borders and list of border countries with distances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes 'total: X km' and enumerates border countries with per-border kilometer figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of the country's coastline in kilometers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single numeric value (example: '37,653 km').

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Territorial sea, exclusive economic zone, continental shelf claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies limits such as 'territorial sea: 12 nm; exclusive economic zone: 200 nm; continental shelf: 200-m depth or to the depth of exploitation'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of climatic zones and seasonal variations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative note on climate range across regions (examples: steppes, humid continental, subarctic, tundra; rainy seasons for Rwanda).

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: General description of physical terrain features.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short summary (examples: 'broad plain with low hills', 'mostly grassy uplands and hills').

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with elevations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as 'lowest point: ...', 'highest point: ...' with meters indicated (example: 'Gora El'brus 5,633 m').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major natural resources and any pertinent note.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates resources (oil, gas, coal, minerals, timber, arable land, etc.) and may include exploitation constraints (example: 'note: formidable obstacles of climate, terrain, and distance hinder exploitation').

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentages of land classified as arable, permanent crops, other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as percentages with year of estimate (example: 'arable land: 7.33%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in sq km.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year of estimate (example: '46,630 sq km (1998 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable natural hazards affecting the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative listing (examples: permafrost, volcanoes, earthquakes, floods, droughts, forest fires).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental challenges and pollution issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative list including air and water pollution, deforestation, soil erosion, contamination from pesticides/radioactivity, waste management problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Treaties and international environmental agreements the country is party to or has signed but not ratified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated list (examples include Biodiversity, Climate Change, Law of the Sea, Kyoto Protocol status).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional geographic commentary or notable facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free-text note emphasizing special geographic observations (example: 'largest country in the world in terms of area but unfavorably located in relation to major sea lanes').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population with date of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric population estimate and reference month/year (example: '143,782,338 (July 2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage distribution of population by age groups (0-14, 15-64, 65+), often with sex breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages with male/female counts sometimes provided for each bracket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age overall and by sex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric median ages with year of estimate (example: 'total: 37.9 years').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate percentage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Given as a percent with year of estimate (example: '-0.45% (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth rate (births per 1,000 population).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (example: '9.63 births/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude death rate (deaths per 1,000 population).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (example: '15.17 deaths/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migration per 1,000 population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (example: '1.02 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratio of males to females at birth and across age groups and total population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple entries indicating sex ratios by age bracket and total (example: 'total population: 0.87 male(s)/female (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, often with male/female breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric values with year (example: 'total: 16.96 deaths/1,000 live births (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy in years for total population and by sex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric years with year of estimate (example: 'total population: 66.39 years').

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of children born per woman.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (example: '1.26 children born/woman (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, number living with HIV/AIDS, and HIV/AIDS deaths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-part set of metrics with numeric estimates and years (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality / Ethnic groups / Religions / Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Identity descriptors including nationality noun/adjective, ethnic composition, major religions, and official/living languages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative lists or percentages (examples: 'Ethnic groups: Russian 81.5%, Tatar 3.8%...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and literacy rates for total population and by sex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition given followed by percent literacy with year (example: 'total population: 99.6% (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name / Conventional long and short forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Official long and short-form country names and local forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed forms and former names where relevant (example: 'conventional long form: Russian Federation').

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of the country's government system (e.g., federation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short descriptor used to categorize political system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the capital city.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single place name (example: 'Moscow').

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Subnational units (oblasts, republics, krays, etc.) and their administrative centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated list of divisions with notes on naming conventions (example includes lists for Russia's oblasts, republics, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence / Constitution / National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Dates of independence, constitution adoption, and national holiday names/dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short factual lines (example: 'Constitution: adopted 12 December 1993').

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Type of legal system and notes on judicial review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short classification (example: 'based on civil law system; judicial review of legislative acts').

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and whether suffrage is universal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Age and statement (example: '18 years of age; universal').

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of state, head of government, cabinet composition, appointment/election details, and notes on presidential administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative including names, election methods, terms, and special notes (examples include presidential powers, appointment of premier, election dates and results).

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure of the national legislature, seat counts, electoral method, terms, and recent election results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on bicameral makeup, number of seats, method of election (party lists, single-member constituencies), thresholds, and example election percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Main courts and judge appointment/tenure rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Names of high courts and description of appointment processes (example: 'judges for all courts are appointed for life by the Federation Council on the recommendation of the president').

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal political parties and named leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated party names with leader names in brackets where provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in or is a member/observer of.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long enumerated lists (examples include UN agencies, regional organizations, trade and security groups).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation (in US / from US)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chiefs of mission, consulates, contact information, and addresses for diplomatic representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists embassy details, consulates general, phone/fax numbers, chancery addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Textual description of the national flag.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short phrase describing colors and patterns (example: 'three equal horizontal bands of white (top), blue, and red').

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative summary of economic performance, structure, strengths, and problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paragraphs discussing GDP growth drivers, vulnerabilities, structural issues (examples: reliance on oil/gas, weak banking, corruption).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total GDP measured by purchasing power parity with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (examples: '$155 billion (2003 est.)', '$1.282 trillion (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual real GDP growth percentage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric percent with year of estimate (examples: '4.9% (2003 est.)', '7.3% (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita measured by purchasing power parity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric dollar value with year (examples: '$7,000 (2003 est.)', '$8,900 (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of GDP from agriculture, industry, and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-part percentage breakdown with year (example: 'agriculture: 13.1% industry: 38.1% services: 48.8% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross fixed capital formation as percent of GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (example: '22.5% of GDP (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of population below the national poverty line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (examples: '44.5% (2000)', '25% (January 2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption by percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Income/consumption share of lowest and highest deciles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages for lowest 10% and highest 10% with year of estimate (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of family income - Gini index
rubrics_metrics.description: Gini coefficient measuring income inequality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric index with year (example: '31.1 (1998)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual consumer price inflation percentage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (example: '15.3% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force size with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year (example: '9.28 million (2003 est.)', '71.68 million (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage distribution of labor force across agriculture, industry, services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-part percentage breakdown with year (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Unemployment percentage and notes on underemployment where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (examples: '7.2% (2003)', '8.5% plus considerable underemployment (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget (revenues/expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Government revenues and expenditures in dollar figures with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-part numeric line including capital expenditures when available (example: 'revenues: $17.06 billion; expenditures: $18.38 billion (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Public debt as percent of GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (examples: '25.5% of GDP (2003)', '34.1% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal agricultural products produced in the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated list of staple crops and livestock products (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Major industrial sectors and manufactured products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative or list describing leading industries (examples: textiles, machinery, metallurgy, chemicals, petroleum refining).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual growth rate of industrial production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year (example: '2.3% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - production / consumption / exports / imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production, consumption, export, and import volumes (kWh).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric values with year and breakdown across production/consumption/exports/imports where provided (examples: 'production: 50.86 billion kWh (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - production / consumption / exports / imports / proved reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil metrics including daily production/consumption, export/import status, and proved reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values provided with units (bbl/day) and reserve quantities with date (examples: 'production: 127,500 bbl/day (2001 est.)'; 'proved reserves: 1.055 billion bbl (1 January 2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - production / consumption / exports / imports / proved reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas metrics with volumes and reserve estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values in cubic meters or billion cu m with year and reserve date (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance in US dollars with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric dollar figure with year (example: '$-3.368 billion (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports / Imports (values)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total export and import values (f.o.b.) with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dollar values with year (examples: 'Exports: $17.63 billion f.o.b. (2003 est.)'; 'Imports: $22.17 billion f.o.b. (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities / Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal commodities exported or imported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated lists (examples: 'textiles and footwear, metals and metal products, machinery and equipment').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners / Imports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Top trading partner countries and percent shares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of countries with percent share figures and year (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold
rubrics_metrics.description: Monetary reserves held in US dollar terms with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric dollar value with year (example: '$10.37 billion (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: Total external debt in US dollars with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric dollar value with year (example: '$18.34 billion (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Amounts and sources of economic aid received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative line listing donors and dollar amounts where applicable (example given for Russia).

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency / Currency code / Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of currency, ISO code, and recent exchange rates against the US dollar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currency name and code plus a time series of exchange rates by year (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiscal year period used by the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short descriptor (example: 'calendar year').

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephones - main lines in use / Telephones - mobile cellular
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of main telephone lines and mobile cellular subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric counts with year (examples: 'Telephones - main lines in use: 4.3 million (2003)'; 'mobile cellular: 6.9 million (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone system
rubrics_metrics.description: General assessment and technical notes on domestic and international telephone systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a 'general assessment' line, description of trunk networks, digital exchange penetration, villages lacking service, country code, satellite earth stations, and participation in international telecom projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio broadcast stations / Television broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of AM/FM/shortwave radio and television broadcast stations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric counts with year (examples: 'AM 40, FM 202, shortwave 3 (1998)'; 'Television broadcast stations: 48 (plus 392 repeaters) (1995)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Radios / Televisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated numbers of radio and television receivers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric counts with year (examples: 'Radios: 7.2 million (1997)'; 'Televisions: 5.25 million (1997)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code / Internet hosts / ISPs / Internet users
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet top-level domain, number of hosts, ISPs, and users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values with year (examples: 'Internet country code: .ro'; 'Internet hosts: 50,807 (2004)'; 'Internet users: 4 million (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Railways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total railway length, electrified length, and gauge breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric lengths and gauge types with year (examples: 'total: 87,157 km; broad gauge: 86,200 km 1.520-m gauge (40,300 km electrified)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of highways and paved vs unpaved breakdown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric lengths with year (examples: 'total: 532,393 km; paved: 358,833 km; unpaved: 173,560 km (2000)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Waterways
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of navigable waterways in kilometers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric value with year and any contextual notes (example: '96,000 km; note: 72,000 km system in European Russia links...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Pipelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Lengths of pipelines by type (gas, oil, condensate, refined products).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric km values with year (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports and harbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Major ports and harbors used for maritime trade.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated list of port names (examples: 'Braila, Constanta, Galati, Mangalia, Sulina, Tulcea').

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of merchant ships (1,000 GRT or over), total GRT/DWT, ownership and types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakdown by total, registered in other countries, foreign-owned, and by type with year (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports / Airports - with paved runways / Airports - with unpaved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of airports and runway surface-length categorizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total airport counts and subdivisions by runway length categories with year (examples: 'Airports: 62 (2003 est.)'; paved runway breakdowns by length).

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of heliports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric count with year (example: '1 (2003 est.)', '36 (Russia)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Names of principal military branches and major combat arms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short enumerated line (examples: 'Ground Forces, Naval Forces, Air and Air Defense Forces (AMR), Civil Defense').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Age and obligation for conscription, availability, fit for service, and number reaching military age annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed lines covering conscription age and duration, registration ages, and numeric availability estimates with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending in dollar figures and as percent of GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-part metric with numeric dollar amount and percent of GDP with year when available (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues - Disputes / Refugees and IDPs / Illicit drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes, refugee and internally displaced person counts, and illicit drug trafficking/production roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative descriptions of unresolved boundary disputes, IDP counts, and role as transshipment point or producer of illicit drugs; may include notes on money laundering vulnerability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Last updated on
rubrics_metrics.description: Date when the country profile page was last updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as 'This page was last updated on DD Month, YYYY' (examples: '10 February, 2005').
